title: Cover letter opening paragraph with fixed facts
prompt_text: Write the opening paragraph of a cover letter, at most 120 words, using only these facts and nothing else. The applicant has four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn. They built a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18 per cent over six months. They led a team of three. The role is Data Analyst at a mid-sized logistics company. The job advert asks for SQL and dashboard experience; the applicant has used SQL occasionally and has never built a dashboard. Do not invent any employer name, project name, dates or additional skills, and do not overstate the SQL experience.
system_prompt: Answer directly if you can do so reliably in a few sentences or a short snippet. If the task needs long multi-step reasoning, reply with exactly the word ESCALATE and nothing else.

Write the opening paragraph of a cover letter, at most 120 words, using only these facts and nothing else. The applicant has four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn. They built a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18 per cent over six months. They led a team of three. The role is Data Analyst at a mid-sized logistics company. The job advert asks for SQL and dashboard experience; the applicant has used SQL occasionally and has never built a dashboard. Do not invent any employer name, project name, dates or additional skills, and do not overstate the SQL experience.

content: I am eager to bring my data expertise to the Data Analyst role at your logistics company. With four years of experience using pandas and scikit-learn, I have developed analytical skills essential for your needs. I built a customer churn model that reduced false-positive alerts by 18% over six months, and led a team of three during this work. While I have used SQL occasionally, my dashboard experience has not yet been developed, and I am keen to apply my analytical background to your organization's needs.
